about.title: About me
about.imageAlt: Mo — hairdresser at NOIR BASEL in Basel
paragraphs: Seven months ago I took a big step: at 25 I moved to Basel to take my career as a hairdresser to the next level. It was a risk, but I knew I had the potential to build something special here. Cutting hair is more than a craft for me — it is a chance to make people happy and give them renewed confidence.

The beginning was not easy. I hardly knew anyone, but I had a vision: to inspire people with modern, creative haircuts. Social media became the perfect platform to showcase my work. With before-and-after clips and authentic insights I built a community step by step — and with it, my success grew.

Today I am grateful for the many clients who trust me and find their best look with enthusiasm. Whether trendy fade cuts, creative colour techniques or complete style transformations — I love making people happy through my craft and giving them a new sense of life.

But this is only the beginning. My dream? To go big! To develop my own product lines, offer training for young hairdressers and pass on my passion for the profession. Above all, I want to keep giving my clients that feeling: a look that makes them proud and brings new joy to their lives.
Basel is my home now — and from here I am stepping into an even bigger future.

agb.seoDescription: Terms and conditions of NOIR BASEL.
agb.title: Terms & conditions

sections.title: § 1 Cancellations
sections.body: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours before the appointment. Late cancellations may be charged up to 100% of the booked service.

sections.title: § 2 Data processing
sections.body: Personal data for bookings is processed only as described in our privacy policy and applicable law.

sections.title: § 3 No-show
sections.body: If you do not attend without prior notice, the full service fee may be charged.

sections.title: § 4 Lateness
sections.body: Significant lateness may shorten or reschedule the appointment at NOIR BASEL’s discretion.

sections.title: § 5 Scope
sections.body: These terms apply to bookings via the website and appointments at NOIR BASEL.

sections.title: § 6 Liability
sections.body: Liability is limited to the extent permitted by law. No liability is assumed for valuables.

sections.title: § 7 Warranty
sections.body: Defects must be reported promptly, at the latest within 5 days after the service.

sections.title: § 8 Final provisions
sections.body: If individual clauses are invalid, the remainder stays in effect. Swiss law applies unless mandatory law provides otherwise.
